<style>
  :root{
    --cream:#FAF8F3;
    --paper:#FFFFFF;
    --green-deep:#1F4A34;
    --green-mid:#2E6B47;
    --green-soft:#E7EFE7;
    --gold:#C9922E;
    --ink:#22261F;
    --muted:#6B7268;
    --line:#E4E0D6;
    --radius:2px;
    --maxw:1120px;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    background:var(--cream);
    color:var(--ink);
    font-family:'Work Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size:16px;
    line-height:1.6;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  h1,h2,h3{
    font-family:'Fraunces', serif;
    font-weight:500;
    margin:0;
    color:var(--green-deep);
  }
  a{color:inherit;}
  img{max-width:100%;display:block;}
  .wrap{max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px;}

  /* Header */
  header{
    position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;
    background:rgba(250,248,243,0.92);
    backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .nav{
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
    padding:18px 28px;max-width:var(--maxw);margin:0 auto;
  }
  .brand{
    display:flex;align-items:center;text-decoration:none;
  }
  .brand-logo{
    height:44px;width:auto;border-radius:4px;
  }
  .nav-links{display:flex;gap:32px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;}
  .nav-links a{
    text-decoration:none;font-size:0.95rem;color:var(--ink);
    border-bottom:1px solid transparent;padding-bottom:2px;
    transition:border-color .2s ease;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover{border-color:var(--gold);}
  .nav-cta{
    display:inline-block;background:var(--green-deep);color:#fff;
    padding:10px 20px;font-size:0.9rem;text-decoration:none;
    border-radius:var(--radius);
  }
  .menu-toggle{display:none;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:4px;}
  .menu-toggle span{display:block;width:24px;height:2px;background:var(--green-deep);margin:5px 0;}

  /* Hero */
  .hero{
    padding:100px 0 90px;
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .hero-grid{
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 0.9fr;gap:56px;align-items:center;
  }
  .eyebrow-line{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:22px;color:var(--gold);
    font-size:0.95rem;
  }
  .eyebrow-line .rule{width:36px;height:1px;background:var(--gold);}
  .hero h1{
    font-size:clamp(2.4rem, 4.3vw, 3.6rem);
    line-height:1.08;
    letter-spacing:-0.5px;
  }
  .hero p.lede{
    margin-top:22px;max-width:46ch;color:var(--muted);font-size:1.08rem;
  }
  .hero-actions{margin-top:34px;display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .btn{
    display:inline-block;padding:13px 26px;text-decoration:none;
    font-size:0.95rem;border-radius:var(--radius);
  }
  .btn-primary{background:var(--green-deep);color:#fff;}
  .btn-outline{border:1px solid var(--ink);color:var(--ink);}

  .hero-art{position:relative;height:380px;}
  .hero-art svg{width:100%;height:100%;}

  /* Trust strip */
  .strip{
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:26px 0;background:var(--paper);
  }
  .strip .wrap{
    display:flex;justify-content:space-between;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:18px;
    font-size:0.92rem;color:var(--muted);
  }
  .strip strong{color:var(--green-deep);font-weight:600;}

  /* Section titles */
  .section{padding:96px 0;}
  .section-head{
    max-width:60ch;margin-bottom:52px;
  }
  .section-head .eyebrow-line{color:var(--gold);}
  .section-head h2{font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3vw,2.4rem);}
  .section-head p{color:var(--muted);margin-top:14px;}

  /* About */
  .about-grid{
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:0.9fr 1.1fr;gap:64px;align-items:start;
  }
  .about-figure{
    background:var(--green-deep);border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:36px;color:#fff;
  }
  .about-figure .num{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;font-size:2.6rem;color:var(--gold);}
  .about-figure .label{font-size:0.95rem;margin-top:6px;color:#DCE6DE;}
  .about-figure-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px;}
  .about-figure-row .about-figure{margin-top:0;}
  .about-text p{color:var(--muted);margin-top:16px;}
  .about-text p:first-child{margin-top:0;}

  /* Products */
  .cat-tabs{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-bottom:36px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .cat-tabs button{
    font-family:'Work Sans',sans-serif;font-size:0.92rem;
    background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--line);
    padding:9px 18px;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink);
    transition:all .2s ease;
  }
  .cat-tabs button.active{background:var(--green-deep);border-color:var(--green-deep);color:#fff;}
  .product-grid{
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:1px;
    background:var(--line);border:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .product-card{
    background:var(--paper);padding:0 0 24px;
  }
  .product-img{
    width:100%;height:150px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    margin-bottom:20px;
  }
  .product-img svg{width:88px;height:88px;}
  .product-card .body{padding:0 26px;}
  .product-card h3{font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;font-family:'Work Sans',sans-serif;}
  .product-card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:0.92rem;margin-top:8px;}
  .product-card[data-cat="spices"]{display:none;}

  /* Why us */
  .why-grid{
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:0;
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .why-item{
    padding:34px 8px 34px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .why-item + .why-item{border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:32px;}
  .why-item .idx{font-family:'Fraunces',serif;color:var(--gold);font-size:1rem;}
  .why-item h3{font-size:1.05rem;margin-top:10px;font-family:'Work Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);}
  .why-item p{color:var(--muted);font-size:0.92rem;margin-top:8px;}

  /* Contact / CTA */
  .cta-section{
    background:var(--green-deep);color:#fff;padding:90px 0;
    border-radius:var(--radius);
  }
  .cta-inner{
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 0.9fr;gap:56px;align-items:center;
  }
  .cta-inner h2{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(1.7rem,3vw,2.3rem);}
  .cta-inner p{color:#CFE0D4;margin-top:16px;max-width:44ch;}
  .contact-card{
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
    padding:34px;border-radius:var(--radius);
  }
  .contact-row{
    display:flex;gap:16px;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.14);
  }
  .contact-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .contact-row .icon{width:20px;height:20px;flex:none;margin-top:2px;color:var(--gold);}
  .contact-row a{text-decoration:none;color:#fff;font-size:0.98rem;}
  .contact-row .label{display:block;font-size:0.78rem;color:#B9CBBD;margin-bottom:2px;}
  .call-btn{
    margin-top:22px;display:block;text-align:center;background:var(--gold);
    color:var(--green-deep);padding:14px;border-radius:var(--radius);
    text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;
  }

  footer{
    padding:36px 0;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:0.86rem;
    border-top:1px solid var(--line);
  }

  @media (max-width: 860px){
    .nav-links{display:none;}
    .menu-toggle{display:block;}
    .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .hero{padding:64px 0 56px;}
    .hero-art{height:260px;order:-1;}
    .about-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px;}
    .product-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
    .why-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
    .why-item + .why-item{border-left:none;padding-left:0;}
    .why-item:nth-child(2n+1){border-left:none;}
    .cta-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .section{padding:64px 0;}
  }
  @media (max-width: 520px){
    .product-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .why-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .strip .wrap{flex-direction:column;gap:10px;}
  }
</style>
</head>

<section class="section" id="why">
